note_en: Machine-readable twin of brief/design-requirements.en.md. If the two ever disagree, this file wins. 'mandatory' items must each be answered (compliance_matrix.json) and, where a metric key is given, declared in metrics.json. 'computed' metrics are recomputed by the self-check from your geometry; a declared value more than 2% away fails GATE-G4.

evidence_tags.computed: Recomputed from the submitted geometry. Must name the geometry file in 'computed_from'.
evidence_tags.sourced: Taken from a cited source. Must name an id in sources.json in 'source'.
evidence_tags.assumed: An assumption. Must name an id in assumptions.json in 'assumption'.
evidence_tags.indicative: Taken from the organiser's indicative material (e.g. zoning/indicative_systems_9_13.json). Not a measurement and not an approval.
evidence_tags.declared: A design figure the scheme chooses (programme, capacity, dwellings, a rule). Must carry a 'note' saying how the scheme arrives at it; any external rate behind it goes in assumptions.json.

mandatory.title: Hourly carbon-free energy match
mandatory.must_state: generation mix, storage duration, and whether the match is physical (self-supplied) or contractual

mandatory.title: Peak IT load in phase one
mandatory.must_state: the grid connection capacity you assumed (not supplied by the organiser)

mandatory.title: Annual water demand, by use
mandatory.must_state: Phase one at full occupancy. The breakdown must add up to the total (2% tolerance); say which line panel-cleaning water sits in.

mandatory.title: Cooling water intensity (WUE)
mandatory.must_state: cooling type: air, liquid, hybrid or dry - and the PUE that goes with it

mandatory.title: Response to a 30% water shortfall
mandatory.must_state: 30% short means 30% less water than your phase-one annual demand (M3). Give a priority order of what stops first, and what happens in the city at each step.

mandatory.title: Human-machine at-grade interfaces
mandatory.must_state: Count every place where a people or shared route meets a machine route on the same level: road crossings, the ends of shared streets, kerbs or loading points that people and machines share, stops of driverless shuttles on a machine route. Grade-separated crossings do not count.

mandatory.title: Machine traffic rule
mandatory.must_state: where each rule applies and how it is enforced

mandatory.title: Public audit mechanism
mandatory.must_state: who publishes power, water, generation and compute data, how often, and who can check it independently

mandatory.title: Control and succession of the compute asset
mandatory.must_state: who owns and operates it, and what happens if that operator leaves

mandatory.title: Triggers for phases two and three
Irreversible decisions
mandatory.must_state: at least three phase-one decisions that cannot be changed later, and why that is acceptable

mandatory.title: Jobs and residents reconcile
mandatory.must_state: if residents far exceed jobs, who the others are and what they live on

scored_metrics.note: name the receiver (greenhouse, district heat, drying ...)
consistent with the cooling type in M4
state the treatment level and the reuse
share of the people network that is shaded; computed if movement.geojson lines carry shaded = true

computed_metrics.how: geodesic area of the master design area
building footprint / master area x 100 (features with form = canopy excluded)
sum of footprint x floors (features with form = canopy excluded)
land_use features with use = open_space / master area x 100
length of people and shared lines with shaded = true / their total length x 100 (only checked if declared as computed)
geodesic area per system; declare as an object {system: km2}

prohibited: Personal data, confidential material or non-public spatial data
A claimed official endorsement, approval or statutory conclusion
Changes to any file outside your own submission directory
not_an_answer: An adjective without a number ('greatly reduced', 'advanced technology', 'efficient use')
A reduction claim with no stated baseline
Waste-heat reuse with no named receiver
A water-shortage response with no priority order
A jobs figure with no skills mix and no named trainer
scope_en: Unless a requirement says otherwise, M1-M12 describe phase one at full build-out and full occupancy. Long-term figures may be added under keys of your own (e.g. long_term_residents).
structure_note_en: structure.geojson areas are land areas, not planning weights. Fixed agrivoltaic context is agri_production; fixed living context is living; see fixed_pilot_context.

minimum_questions: settlement and centre hierarchy, including undeveloped land
five system locations, approximate scales and relationships
primary internal and external transport and human-machine connections
resource infrastructure and declared capacities or assumptions
connections to both pilot parts and both parcels
phasing relationships and observable expansion triggers
whole_site_structure.not_sufficient: A coloured zoning diagram covering the whole site alone.

flood_data_interpretation.seasonal_channels: Permanent construction on actual dry channels is prohibited; supplied lines and check buffers are DEM-derived indicators for review.
flood_data_interpretation.flood_sensitive_screening: Approximately 503 km2; not a verified design-flood boundary, statutory setback or blanket permanent no-build zone. Outside screening does not establish flood safety.

living.legacy_note: Listed legacy packages retain the old agriculture context label for compatibility only; content review must correct its meaning on migration. No redesign is permitted.

review_status_note: Automatic compliance is separate from design content review; G12 checks evidence existence only.

levels.title: Whole-site structure
levels.question_zh: 城镇、生产、保护、交通、资源与增长的关系
levels.question_en: Settlements, production, protection, transport, resources and growth
levels.spatial_evidence: Whole-issued-site base zoning with named/numbered polygons, primary uses and geometric area/share account; primary/secondary road skeleton, centres, district and external-access links; separate overlapping systems and phasing.
decisions: Site suitability, development and protection
Locations, capacities and dependencies of all five systems
Settlements and centres
Primary movement and external access
Resource infrastructure
Population, jobs, land and resource scenarios
Starting point, growth and conditional phases

levels.title: Complete city layout and phased implementation
levels.question_zh: 完整城市如何组织、容纳多少人，并按什么顺序建设
levels.question_en: How the complete city is organised, its capacities and construction sequence
levels.spatial_evidence: Coordinated city-scale structure, functional programme, street/mobility, ecology/landscape, land-use and public-space/service diagrams; complete layout across all phases; matching overall axonometric or birdseye view and capacity/phase accounts
decisions: Complete planned development extent and capacities across all phases
District hierarchy, living and production relationships
Public-service and utility locations, scale and connections
Phase 1/2/3 construction extents, objectives, durations, dependencies and triggers
Independent operation of the first phase if later works stop

levels.title: Urban design enlargement
levels.question_zh: 总体布局如何形成街道、街区和公共生活
levels.question_en: How the master layout forms streets, blocks and public life
levels.spatial_evidence: Block plan, building heights/massing, public space and decisive sections
decisions: At least a complete block or spatial unit
Continuous streets and blocks
Massing, height and density
Centres, services and accessible routes
Public interfaces and separated or shared flows
Terrain, heat, wind and drainage responses

levels.title: Three detailed nodes
levels.question_zh: 位置、使用者、空间组织与运行方式
levels.question_en: Location, users, spatial organisation and operation
levels.spatial_evidence: Locator, detailed plan, necessary sections/elevations, massing and concept views
decisions: Whole-site and master-area location and phase
Upper-level promise tested
Users, arrival, stay and operation
Buildings, paths, vegetation, shade, terrain and water relationships
Dimensions and interfaces
Normal use and relevant abnormal conditions

review_states.automatic: File, geometry, numeric and version checks only
review_states.further_work: Entrant-declared gaps, next verification and responsibility

planning_boundary.whole_site: Fixed organiser-defined scope_9_13.geojson; the overall plan must cover the entire site.
planning_boundary.phase_one: Justify independently operable first-phase settlement areas and associated production/infrastructure within the whole-site structure. They may be spatially separate and require evidenced operational links; this does not reduce the overall planning boundary.
planning_boundary.overall_layout: The full planned city and associated facilities across all development phases, not only the first district. Urban-design enlargements may be one or multiple coherent areas and need not contain all nodes.

design_depth.matrix_v1_compatibility: Only the two organiser-listed legacy paths may retain v1 matrices. New directories must use v2; entrants cannot self-declare an earlier rule version.

construction_programme.spatial_evidence: Overall construction-phase map and staged detail where needed: installed versus operating works, utility capacity, future reserve, construction access and isolation of occupied areas.

themes.question_zh: 城市怎样组织：中心层级、各区角色、主要发展轴、边缘和地区之间的联系。
themes.question_en: How the city is organised: centre hierarchy, district roles, principal axes, edges and relationships between districts.
themes.spatial_evidence: Show named centres/districts, their scale or capacity and the connections that make them one settlement system.

themes.question_zh: 居住、公共与商业服务、算力生产、农业、物流等放在哪里，为什么相邻或分开。
themes.question_en: Where housing, civic/commercial services, computing/production, agriculture and logistics go, and why uses adjoin or separate.
themes.spatial_evidence: Locate functional areas and anchors; show necessary adjacencies, compatible mixtures, service links and reasoned conflicts or separations.

themes.question_zh: 城市怎样进入及运行：主入口、路网层级、公共交通、步行骑行、生产物流与关键接口。
themes.question_en: How the city is reached and works: main access, street hierarchy, public transport, walking/cycling, freight and decisive interfaces.
themes.spatial_evidence: Draw connected routes, hierarchy, main arrivals, crossings and service/freight access; distinguish proposed external approaches from secured access.

themes.question_zh: 地形、季节沟道、保护与开放空间怎样形成连续格局，种植和遮阴如何回应水与气候。
themes.question_en: How terrain, seasonal channels, protection and open space form a connected landscape, and how planting/shade respond to water and climate.
themes.spatial_evidence: Show linked corridors and open spaces, drainage/terrain relationships and evidence status; do not invent lakes, permanent green cover or surveyed flood limits.

themes.question_zh: 土地按什么单元安排，用地类别、混合方式、面积与容量如何对应。
themes.question_en: How land is allocated by spatial unit, with use categories, mixed-use conventions, areas and capacities.
themes.spatial_evidence: Show readable development blocks or appropriate land units, categories and legend; reconcile land areas and capacity assumptions without double counting.

themes.question_zh: 居民与工作者在哪里活动、获得服务，各级中心和社区如何被联系起来。
themes.question_en: Where residents and workers gather and obtain services, and how centres and neighbourhoods connect.
themes.spatial_evidence: Locate civic anchors, schools/health/markets and public spaces; show service hierarchy, walking connections and declared capacity/catchment assumptions.

city_system_diagrams.automatic_checks: Check declared paths, numeric/version links and packaging only; thematic adequacy, useful abstraction and image fidelity require content review.

whole_site_plan.automatic_checks: Full-site polygon coverage/overlap, required attributes and explicit road classes only; no design-quality or engineering approval.
whole_site_plan.boundary_reasoning: Explain district role/users, spatial edge logic, source/assumption, access/service relationship, capacity and phase/resource dependency in existing proposal/accounts. Automatic coverage does not verify this reasoning.

a0_presentation.key_numbers: Only figures needed to understand scale, capacities, decisive constraints or construction choices; scope/evidence labelled.
